questions.text: No calculator: 4 people each pick a whole number from 1 to 250, uniformly and independently (repeats allowed; 1 and 250 are not neighbours). Estimate the probability that no two of the numbers differ by 2 or less (within 5%).

questions.working: mean 66.5, variance 19 x 35/12 = 55.42; continuity-correct to 62 - 1/2, z = -0.672, so 1 - Phi(-0.672) = 0.7491
